text: Middle East Conflict | ‘Not America’s War’: Oman Asks US Allies To Help Exit Iran Conflict | News18Oman has urged US allies to help Washington exit the escalating Iran war, calling for restraint and renewed diplomacy. The Gulf nation, which has long mediated US-Iran talks, warned against further escalation and stressed that military action will not serve long-term regional stability. #BreakingNews #Oman #IranWar #USIranConflict #MiddleEastCrisis #Geopolitics #WorldNews #IranIsraelWar #GlobalTensions #Diplomacy n18oc_breaking-news
